FINAL CHECKS · ITEM 04 / 05

Traded quantity and graph assumptions交易量與圖形假設

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

When a numerical answer depends on a graph, identify the quantity actually traded and any stated assumptions about rationing, taxes or subsidies before calculating areas.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

畫面積前先確定售出量及有效價格。管制下自願交易取較小供需量；商品分給誰也會影響福利。

Before measuring areas, establish actual traded quantity and the effective price paid or received. Under controls, the short side limits voluntary trade and allocation assumptions determine who gets the units.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Ceiling gives Qd=80,Qs=50. Use at most 50 traded units for welfare, then state which buyers obtain them. 需求八十不能當作已售八十。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

With Qd=100,Qs=60 under a ceiling and no extra supply, maximum voluntary trades? 最多交易量？
